definitions.rising: Heat履歴2点以上・6時間以上のspanが揃った記事を対象に、直近24時間のHeat上昇率で算出。

latest.summary: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group released PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20 and 14.25 on November 12, fixing 52 security vulnerabilities and more than 140 other bugs. Most of those code execution bugs are memory errors or type confusion, where PostgreSQL handles a value as the wrong data type. hottest.summary: On 12 November 2026, the Cloud Software Group published security bulletins for its Citrix products addressing 28 memory flaws in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway. One of these vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-120868, affects every deployment, including those using the default configuration. The vendor bulletin describes the impact as unpredictable behaviour and denial of service. Citrix reports no exploitation, and no public proof-of-concept has been confirmed. CERT-EU strongly recommends upgrading all customer-managed NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances to the fixed releases. Internet-facing Gateway and AAA appliances should be upgraded first.
